issue_title: Home page performance dropped to 83 (below 85 threshold) — TBT spike to 198 ms
issue_body:
## Performance regression: `/` performance 88 → 83

**Audited:** 2026-09-24T13:33:35.559Z

### What changed
| Metric | Previous | Current | Δ |
|--------|----------|---------|---|
| Performance | 88 | **83** | −5 |
| LCP | 3574 ms | 3808 ms | +234 ms |
| TBT | 90 ms | **198 ms** | +108 ms ⚠️ |
| CLS | 0.015 | 0.015 | — |

The home page performance score crossed below the 85 threshold. The primary driver is a **TBT spike from 90 ms to 198 ms**, suggesting a main-thread blocking script that wasn't present (or was deferred) in the previous run. LCP also crept up by ~234 ms.

### Likely causes
- A third-party or first-party script (animation library, analytics, etc.) may have been loaded synchronously or earlier in the critical path.
- Hero images may not be served as next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF), contributing to LCP.

### Recommended fixes
1. **Audit blocking scripts** on `/` — defer or async-load any non-critical JS (particle animations, analytics, tracking).
2. **Convert hero device-mockup images to WebP/AVIF** to reduce LCP.
3. Re-run Lighthouse after each change to confirm improvement (scores jitter ±3 pts, so target ≥88 to have a safe buffer above 85).

### Also still below 85
- `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue`: 80 (LCP 4355 ms — image format optimisation is the top fix)
- `/projects/note-structurer`: 84 (LCP 3939 ms — marginal, likely resolves with same image fix)

### Visuals
No visual breakage detected on any page across desktop or mobile.
